slides.title: Text pe [[jaadu]] kyun?
slides.note: Text ko badlo, **table ka data same** rehta hai. Sirf output change

slides.title: Sab ek [[query]] mein
slides.code:
SELECT
  UPPER(name) AS caps,
  LENGTH(name) AS letters,
  CONCAT(name, ' - ', city)
    AS label
FROM employees;
slides.note: AS se naya column ka **naam** do, warna header ajeeb dikhega

slides.title: Ek kaam, [[teen naam]]
slides.note: MySQL mein **CHAR_LENGTH** letters ginta hai, LENGTH bytes 🤯

slides.title: [[TRIM]] ka asli kaam
points: Form mein user ne daala: '  Riya  '
slides.note: Search ya JOIN fail ho raha? Pehle **spaces** check karo

slides.wrong: SQL Server mein bhi **LENGTH(name)** likh diya
slides.why: Function ke naam **har DB mein same nahi**. Error aaye to docs dekho 📖

points: Naam DB ke hisaab se check karo
